# /uptime

Show how long the bot has been running.

Shows when the bot last started.

## Commands

- [`/uptime bot`](#bot): Show the bot's current uptime

## /uptime bot {#bot}

Show the bot's current uptime.

It takes no options.

**Who can run it:** Anyone, in a server or in DMs.

!!! example "Example"
    You type `/uptime bot`.

    The bot answers with a message; everyone in the channel sees it:

    > Online since Tuesday 3 November 2026 09:00 (2 hours ago)
